lines.text: Add an application-owned sidecar rather than changing `mw.training-export.v1` admission semantics. Record exact GP graph/program/checkpoint, feature projection, actor/selector, legal support at sample time, proposed vs admitted vs executed action, actual source receipt and final feedback status. Post-proposal admission is **not** original sampler support. Unknown/pending feedback cannot be invented as observed reward; global team outcome alone does not attribute causal benefit to each actor.
3. GP computes keyed agent/task pair logits or graph value with program/checkpoint/snapshot hash, finite resource budget and explicit abstain status.

6. Sidecar correlates observation, sampled decision and behavior log probability, resulting proposal, resolver verdict, source-owned effect receipt and external verifier outcome. Feedback corrections and promotion remain outside the policy's evaluation.

Original Policy/reconcile laws unchanged; pure GP call, exact source ID mapping, original behavior probability, no native-effect bypass, stale result rejection, evidence sidecar parity and Forge-installed integration tests before any runtime rollout.
